II. רסס (√ of following; Late Hebrew רָסַס Pi`el break, crush ; so Mandean רסס Norberg Lexid. 232 , Jewish-Aramaic רְסַס ; compare Arabic well stopped up with stones Hoffm ZAW iii (1893), 115 ). II. [ רָסִיס ] noun [masculine] fragment ; — plural רְסִיסִים , of houses destroyed Amos 6:11 (|| בְּקִעִים ). רֹעַ רַע, see I. רעע . I. רֵעַ see רוע . p. 929, 947f II, III. רֵעַ see רעה .
